family_summary: Across the 28 sites, AI-built pages typically rebuild typography into a uniform, modern convention: system-ui or Georgia/Helvetica pairings at about 16–17px with 1.6–1.65 line height, visible bold h1s and h2s (often navy or white, sentence case), added uppercase letterspaced eyebrow labels, and fewer all-caps or decorative treatments.
